properties.name: The roll-up's blind spot becomes a question — a decomposition is asked what it dropped, and the prerequisite Anthony named for reopening the tier shape is now met. Alex's fourth note: he wanted a top-level graph over component graphs, and the shape was deferred behind THIS (dec:idea-a-top-level-graph-holds-what-the-component-graphs-share, option e) because settling a tier shape on a broken roll-up would bake the defect into the boundary where nobody can see it.
